 Punjab State Lottery Result Today (09-11-2026) LIVE: Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery Result DECLARED
 Personal Finance oi-Madhulika Pandey By Madhulika Pandey 
 Published: Monday, November 9, 2026, 17:03 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Punjab State Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery Result for November 9, 2026, is scheduled to be announced today. Lottery participants can check the winning numbers for Dear 50 Draw No. 68, which carries a first prize of Rs 21 lakh.
 The Punjab lottery results for Monday weekly draw is scheduled for 6:30 PM at the Camp Office in Ludhiana, Punjab. Each lottery ticket is priced at Rs 50.
 The Punjab lottery Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery offers several prize categories, including consolation prizes and rewards for matching the last four digits of the winning number.
 Punjab lottery Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery Prize Structure
 The Dear 50 lottery has four ticket series, A, B, C and D with ticket numbers ranging from 00000 to 99999.
The prize structure for Draw No. 68 is as follows:
 First Prize: Rs 21 lakh
Consolation Prize: Rs 10,000 
Second Prize: Rs 9,000
Third Prize: Rs 3,000
Fourth Prize: Rs 2,000
Fifth Prize: Rs 1,000
Sixth Prize: Rs 500
Seventh Prize: Rs 100
 How to Check Punjab State Dear 50 Lottery Result
 Lottery participants should check the winning numbers and ticket series carefully after the draw. The five-digit number and series are important for identifying the first-prize winner.
 Participants are advised to verify their tickets against the official lottery result and prize list before claiming any prize. Prize claims are subject to the applicable Punjab State Lottery rules and verification procedures.
 How to claim Punjab State Dear 50 Beast Lottery Prize
 If your ticket wins a prize in the Punjab State Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery, here is how you can claim your winnings.
 Prizes below Rs 10,000: These may be claimed through authorised lottery retailers or agents in Punjab.
Prizes from Rs 10,000 to Rs 1 lakh: Contact the Punjab State Lottery Office for claim submission.
Prizes above Rs 1 lakh: Submit the claim through the Directorate of Punjab State Lotteries.
 Documents required For Claim
 Keep the following documents ready:
 Original winning lottery ticket, signed on the reverse.
 Prescribed lottery prize claim form.
 Aadhaar card or other valid identity proof.
 PAN card.
 Passport-size photographs.
 Bank account details and IFSC code.
 Cancelled cheque or bank passbook copy.
 Attested photocopy of the winning ticket.
 Affidavit confirming ownership of the ticket, where required.
